title: The black mailbox began as a vague landmark

tellings.quote: So, I just said, "It's around the black mailbox."

plain: The black mailbox, a lone mailbox in the Nevada desert that later became a famous spot for UFO watchers, first became a landmark because of an offhand answer in 1989. Bob Lazar, a well-known figure in UFO circles whom Jesse Michels spent two days with, says he simply told people the sightings were "around the black mailbox" to keep the location vague.
